title: Modified Run-Length Encoding

type_declarations: type 'a rle = One of 'a | Many of int * 'a

entrypoints.name: encode
entrypoints.semantics: Return the ordered list of maximal adjacent-equality runs. A singleton run is One x; every run of count n >= 2 is Many (n, x).

synquid_lowering.note: RleList is a logical/source-level homogeneous wrapper required by Synquid measure signatures; it is not an additional OCaml public type.

trusted_primitives.name: eq
trusted_primitives.role: Generic equality decision used to branch on adjacent values during synthesis.

trusted_primitives.name: integer literals and addition
trusted_primitives.synquid_role: Built-in refinement/expression arithmetic used only to express or construct run counts 2 and n + 1.

excluded_from_interface: No seed or random source is added.
No exception, option, result, mutable state, stream, string-specialized, or float-specialized entrypoint is added.
